description: Call first in every session. Returns who you act for, what your grant allows, the owner's party, offerings and open needs, and every item waiting for a response: incoming questions, quote requests, orders, bookings, contact proposals, new matches, approvals. Each item has `respond_with` (tool, allowed actions, args template). Actionable items stay until handled, so you need no memory between sessions. Informational items are shown once; pass `since` to see them again.

since.description: Re-show informational items after this time. Default: since your previous inbox call.
